articles.title: Ethereum app builder Consensys has delayed its potential IPO until fall
articles.snippet: The MetaMask wallet builder had reportedly engaged bankers from JPMorgan and Goldman Sachs to lead the process.

articles.title: Crypto wallet provider Ledger puts U.S. IPO plans on hold due to market conditions
articles.snippet: The French crypto security firm, which is said to have explored a potential $4 billion U.S. listing, is reassessing its public market plans as volatile conditions weigh on investor appetite for crypto IPOs.

articles.title: Anthropic, OpenAI tokens plunge as AI firms say pre-IPO share transfers are invalid
articles.snippet: Tokens on Solana that claim to track the private-market valuations of Anthropic and OpenAI dropped sharply this week after both AI companies warned that the structures used to back the tokens may be invalid.

articles.title: Live markets: Bitcoin dips below $80,000 as producer price inflation surges to 6%
articles.snippet: U.S. PPI surged well above forecasts in April, reviving concerns that rising oil prices and Iran-related supply risks may feed another inflation wave.

articles.title: Bitcoin back above $81,000 after hot CPI print, BNB, DOGE lead majors gains
articles.snippet: Bitcoin rolled back to $81,200 after dipping to $79,800 on Tuesday's hotter-than-expected U.S. inflation reading, while BNB zoomed 2.5% over 24 hours and dogecoin added 1.3% as crypto funds saw their strongest weekly inflows in months.
